ease.reason: A beginner can test fictional invoice rows and email text; field mapping and reliable extraction remain untested.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: bookkeeping practices may pay for less retyping; this community post establishes no buyers or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week prototype can turn supplied sample invoices into spreadsheet rows; live mail access and accuracy need testing.

autonomy.reason: Repeated extraction and row formatting could be automated, but a bookkeeper must verify amounts and approve entries.

evidence.reason: The post directly states that bookkeepers retype emailed vendor invoices into a spreadsheet, with little detail on frequency or rules.
